Fists of Bane are the lowest rank of foot soldiers of Bane who obey all orders without hesitation.

Involvement

Act Three

Fists of Bane are Banite soldiers and enforcers. They are present in various places of interest around Baldur's Gate, such as Felogyr's Fireworks, Baldur's Mouth, and the Steel Watch Foundry.

Combat

Fists of Bane are potent melee fighters who can be buffed by their fellow Iron Consults of Bane.
